import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", rc={"axes.facecolor": (0.9, 0.9, 0.95)})

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7))

# --- Plot 1: Survival Rate by Class and Sex ---
ax1 = axes[0]
sns.barplot(x='class', y='survived', hue='sex', data=df, ax=ax1, palette={'male': 'skyblue', 'female': 'salmon'}, errorbar=None)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))
ax1.legend(title='Sex')

# Add annotations to the bars
for p in ax1.patches:
    ax1.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
                   (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                   ha='center', va='center',
                   xytext=(0, 9),
                   textcoords='offset points',
                   fontsize=10,
                   color='black')

# --- Plot 2: Age Distribution by Survival Status ---
ax2 = axes[1]
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='age', hue='alive', fill=True, ax=ax2,
            palette={'no': 'firebrick', 'yes': 'seagreen'}, common_norm=False)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Status', labels=['Survived', 'Did Not Survive'])
ax2.set_xlim(0, 80)

# Add a vertical line for the median age
median_age = df['age'].median()
ax2.axvline(median_age, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5)
ax2.text(median_age + 2, ax2.get_ylim()[1]*0.8, f'Median Age: {median_age:.1f}',
         rotation=90, verticalalignment='center', color='grey', weight='bold')


# Overall title for the figure
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis: Key Factors', fontsize=18, weight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
